checks.name: Row-derived classification and model-count totals (P0 correction, added after PR review)
checks.command: grep -c "| FOUND |" / "| PARTIAL |" / "| NOT FOUND IN INSPECTED SCOPE |" STATE02_GATE_INVENTORY_REGISTER_v1.0.md; grep -c "^| [0-9] |" (Section 3 model table) in STATE02_GATE_CROSSWALK_v1.0.md
checks.expected: Classification totals recomputed directly from the Classification column of every row (not hand-tallied or copied from prose), summing to 37, with exactly one Classification per Gate ID; model-count prose consistent with the row count of the Section 3 model table
checks.actual: FOUND=12, PARTIAL=20, NOT FOUND IN INSPECTED SCOPE=5, sum=37, each of the 37 Gate ID rows carries exactly one Classification value (verified: no row contains a '/' or multiple classification tokens); Section 3 model table = 6 rows, all prose in STATE02_GATE_CROSSWALK_v1.0.md now says 'six' consistently (previously said 'five' in two places while the table had 6 rows — corrected)
checks.note: This check did not exist in the original v1.0 validation pass and was added specifically because a PR review comment identified: (a) GATE-018 had been given two Classification values, making the prior hand-written FOUND=12 total not actually derivable from the table (13 IDs were listed against a stated total of 12), and (b) the Crosswalk's prose said 'five models' against a 6-row table. Both were real defects in the original commit, not false alarms. Both are corrected in this same commit; CHECK-009 is now a permanent, mechanical, row-derived check rather than a prose cross-check, so this class of defect cannot recur silently.
